```{r init, message = FALSE, echo = FALSE, results = "hide", warning=FALSE}
library(BiocStyle)
library(ScoutMRMBuilder)
library(Spectra)
library(MsBackendMsp)
library(BiocParallel)
register(SerialParam())
```

# Introduction

# Package usage
## Data import
*ScoutMRMBuilder* can be used with spectrum from DIA or DDA spectra in every file format than can be read with *Spectra* package. For demonstration purpose we will use spectra collected by DDA acquisition on Zeno TOF 7600 on controle quality sample of pig biopsy in ischemia-reperfusion injury.
```{r load data,message=FALSE}
# Get th full path of .msp file and .csv file 
fls <- dir(system.file("extdata", package = "ScoutMRMBuilder"), full.names = TRUE,recursive = TRUE)

#Load .mgf file in a Spectra object
Spectra_data <- Spectra(fls[2],source= MsBackendMsp())

#Load .csv file database of scout 
Scout_DB <- read.csv(fls[1],sep=";")
```

`r length(Spectra_data)` spectra have been collected in untargeted data with require inforamtion (retention time and precursor intensity). Collected spectra can be look in mz-rt dimension using `Viz_spectra_mz_rt()` function. 

```{r viz spectra data,message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
Viz_spectra_mz_rt(Spectra_data,feature_id =TRUE)
```

## Ion pairs generation
Next, ion pairs can be generated using `Generate_ions_pairs()` with n pairs for each precursor, in this case 3 ion pairs will be generated.
```{r ion pairs,message=FALSE }
Paires_ions <- Generate_ions_pairs(Spectrum = Spectra_data, pairs_per_precursor = 3)
head(Paires_ions)
``` 

## Scout search

Once ion pairs are generated, scout compounds are search using `Scout_Search()` with a tolerance of 10 ppm on precursor and fragments ions.  
```{r search scout,message=FALSE,results='hide'}
Scout_trouve <- Scout_Search(database_scout = Scout_DB, Ion_pairs = Paires_ions, ppm_Q1 = 10, ppm_Q3 = 10 )
```

`r nrow(Scout_trouve)` scouts have been found in ions pairs. And can be visualize using `Viz_spectra_mz_rt_with_Scout()` function
```{r, viz Scout,message=FALSE ,warning=FALSE}
Viz_spectra_mz_rt_with_Scout(Paires_ions,Scout_trouve)
```


## StMRM method creation

Finaly, StMRM method(s) can be build. 

Paramètres   | Usage
------- | -----
limitation_transi_group | Number of transitions per group
chooseSMRM  | Select precursor most intense "max" less intense "min" or all precursors "all"
treshold_detection | Scout treshold
DW.Scout | Dwell time for scout transition
polarity | Polarity for targeted analysis used for compute CE CXP DP & EP (0 NEG et 1 POS)
```{r creation methode SCOUT-MRM, message=FALSE}
Methode_Scout_MRM <- Build_ScoutMRM_method(Scout_trouve[-c(26:38),],Paires_ions,limitation_transi_group = 200,chooseSMRM = "all",treshold_detection=200,DW.Scout=10,polarity = 1)

```
